raw_packet.full_request:
덕테이프 포스터로 주말 식물 마켓을 홍보해줘. SNS에 올릴 16:9 가로 포스터 다섯 장이 필요해. 각각 전체 스타일과 레이아웃이 달랐으면 좋겠어. 식물을 고르고 집에서 돌보는 즐거움이 느껴지도록 만들고, 긴 설명과 방문 안내가 자연스럽게 읽히게 해줘. 큰 고딕 제목과 정보 블록에 작은 이미지나 질감을 붙이는 단색 템플릿은 제외해줘. 로고·QR·새 문구 없이 다음 문구를 각 한 번씩 정확히 넣어줘.

집 안의 작은 숲
LEAVES & LIVING
초록을 고르고, 일상을 가꿉니다.
작은 화분부터 오래 키운 나무까지 만납니다. 재배자의 이야기를 듣고, 우리 집의 빛과 생활에 맞는 식물을 골라보세요.
성수 주말 식물 마켓
2027.06.12–06.13
토·일 11:00–19:00
성수 온실마당
입장 무료 · 분갈이 시연
식물 구매 시 관리 안내 제공
편하게 들러 천천히 둘러보세요.

compact_recording.execution: Inside the same fresh critic session before immutable CLI completion; no post-completion export

procedure_errors: editorial: trace contains a failed turn/error

procedure.method: Independent fresh editorial review. Read only the explicitly pinned inputs. The packet has no source assets and no protected layouts, so those opening/read arrays are empty. Read all five pinned native-evidence manifests before poster opening, without following their embedded unlisted source/input/final paths. Verified supplied byte hashes as binding checks, not as viewing evidence. Actually opened and visually inspected each exact pinned poster via tools.view_image with detail original, emitted at original detail, in this sequence: M1 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M2 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M3 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M4 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M5 native, usage720, thumbnail320. All fifteen opens were completed before beginning poster text reading/transcription or any judgment/score. Then read the visible text from those native views and assessed readability and composition against the completed usage and thumbnail views. No OCR, crops, replacement assets, image editing, additional image opens, revisits, peer records or maker explanations were used. View receipts attest to the actual image outputs seen, not a helper exit. Session identity is left null for the runner; no event identifiers are invented.

issues: The literal full-five distinct-system condition is not fully met: M2 and M5 both use a large static plant at the right of a domestic scene, an enlarged non-title sentence and explanation in the upper-left, and visit information in the lower-left. Their change of photographic to illustrated finish, furniture and headline sentence does not sufficiently change that shared reading scaffold. This set-wide condition is included in this member's literal style roll-up.

evidence.location: whole poster
evidence.observation: A single flat opaque landscape design with two substantial photographic plant images and open serif/sans type treatment. No tape-material requirement is imposed. No logo, QR, watermark or extra wording is visible; the twelve visible copy entries each occur once. No source assets or protected geometry are supplied.

evidence.location: horizontal photograph and right portrait photograph
evidence.observation: A hand presents a small potted plant on the left; a larger living plant sits beside a chair and daylight on the right. The pairing connects choosing a small plant with keeping a plant at home. These images occupy a large part of the design, rather than being tiny ornaments or background texture.

evidence.location: left explanation and two lower information groups
evidence.observation: The full explanation, event/date/hours/place, access/care, invitation and URL can all be read. Their grouping is usable, although the place is offset and benefits start left of the portrait image edge. This is an image/text diptych, rather than a passive gothic headline with subordinate tiny imagery.

evidence.location: whole-set relationship

evidence.location: both tabletop plants
evidence.observation: A large leafy plant in a terracotta pot, a smaller trailing plant and coherent cast shadows are substantial nonglyph content occupying the scene.

evidence.location: sunlit tabletop beside window
evidence.observation: Living plants in different sizes are placed in actual home light. The window, leaf highlights and pot placement substantiate the copy about choosing plants for household light and enjoying them at home.

content_form.location: small plant, tall plant and diagonal window light
content_form.observation: The two sizes and their home-light placement provide a concrete visual counterpart to the explanation about small pots, grown plants and matching household light. The scene has no explicit care action, but domestic growth is legible.

hierarchy.location: upper headline and lower two columns
hierarchy.observation: The large slogan is the first text focus; explanation sits immediately beneath it. Market/hours/access and date/place/care form coordinated lower columns, ending in invitation and URL. The small title/brand works as a corner identifier.

typography.location: cream top copy and dark bottom copy
typography.observation: Consistent sans forms, intact punctuation and clear word spaces support the dense required information. Changes in weight separate slogan and event from paragraph and details.
Contrast is sufficient on both wall planes, and lower details and URL remain readily readable.

space.observation: The window-light diagonal and large right plant balance the top sentence and lower text pairs. The middle gap continues the tabletop/shadow scene instead of becoming an unmotivated blank panel. Margins and paired baselines are controlled.

image_material.location: right plant and both pots
image_material.observation: Leaf veins, soil, pot wear and leaf/pot shadows have coherent photographic construction. The window illumination connects the wall and table; no major malformed object is visible.

emotion_control.observation: Rich green leaves and golden sunlight create a welcoming domestic afternoon atmosphere, appropriate to slow selection and long-term plant care. The contrast remains warm rather than alarm-like.

ai_slop.observation: The scene remains focused on two plants without arbitrary badges or motifs, and the copy has no apparent generated glyph errors. Visible object/shadow detail is coherent at native scale.

procedure.method: This fresh independent critic read the exact pinned packet, case, rubric, review rules, recording addendum, ratio policy and compact schema. Verified the pinned SHA-256 and byte counts and read all five supplied image manifests before poster viewing, without following their unlisted embedded paths. The packet declares no source assets and no protected layouts, so the source and protected-layout receipt arrays are explicitly empty. Actually opened and inspected every poster using tools.view_image, emitting the images at original detail in five sequential functions.exec calls. Within each call the awaited opens were original.png/native, usage-720.png/usage720, then thumbnail-320.png/thumbnail320; calls proceeded M1, M2, M3, M4, M5. All fifteen exact displayed images were inspected before starting the first copy transcription or any judgment or score. First raw readings were then taken from the completed native displays, with separate observations of the already viewed usage and thumbnail displays. No image reopens or ambiguity revisits were needed. No source opening or trace/session event is invented. PNG headers confirm all natives 1672x941, usage views 720x405 and thumbnails 320x180. The native ratio is not mathematically exact 16:9; 941 differs from 1672*9/16 by 0.5 pixel and therefore passes the predeclared nearest-integer-single-edge exception. Usage width is 720 and thumbnail maximum edge is 320; both preserve the aspect within integer dimensions. No image was generated, edited or substituted.

evidence.location: caregiver diagonal and upper-right paragraph

evidence.location: table opening, sill opening and invitation headline

typography.location: right half of the third explanation line
typography.observation: Cream sans-serif text loses contrast as the line crosses onto sunlit tan, especially the phrase ending with 식물을 골라보세요. Its visibility is markedly weaker than the same paragraph over green.
The glyphs and punctuation themselves are intact and the URL is contiguous; the unresolved issue is optical readability against the changing background.

space.observation: The high paragraph is held between the small name at left and right plant; the lower surface provides a broad, aligned two-column information area. The plant and long shadows occupy the remaining right and lower space purposefully.

image_material.location: pot surfaces, leaf highlights and cast shadows
image_material.observation: Terracotta texture, leaf gloss, rim geometry, soil and shadows are coherent with warm window light. The plants sit convincingly on the same scene plane without obvious construction breaks.

emotion_control.observation: Strong afternoon light and warm clay pots communicate pleasurable domestic plant ownership. The effect is inviting without relying on unrelated decorative motifs.

ai_slop.observation: No obvious malformed plant joins, duplicated arbitrary ornaments, broken lettering or incoherent pot contacts are visible; the scene's light structure is coherent. The paragraph contrast failure is retained separately.

residuals: The final portion of the explanation crosses a bright region in cream type; typography is below the professional floor and the literal comfortable-readability condition fails.

evidence.location: left person, central lifted plant and lower-right pot
evidence.observation: The person's body, hands, foliage, roots and pot occupy most of the lower and left page and make a legible caregiving scene.

evidence.location: hands supporting exposed roots beside an empty pot
evidence.observation: The root ball being handled beside a larger pot directly communicates repotting and sustained plant care, making the stated demonstration and care advice meaningful.

content_form.location: person concentrating on root ball and empty pot
content_form.observation: The exposed roots, soil and potting gesture directly visualize plant care and the market's repotting demonstration; the portrait supplies a human relationship to cultivation.

hierarchy.location: upper-right paragraph versus lower-left identity
hierarchy.observation: The long explanatory paragraph is the dominant text mass, while the poster name sits across the page at bottom left. The eye is divided between the worker/root ball and the paragraph before the smaller event name establishes what is being promoted.

hierarchy.location: right text block
hierarchy.observation: The tagline, event name and utility rows form several similar-sized layers under the very large paragraph, leaving a functional but insufficiently differentiated message sequence.

typography.observation: The large serif paragraph, cream title on the apron, and dark sans-serif attendance lines use distinct type roles without malformed glyphs. Optical spaces around the middle dot in hours remain separate from word spacing.
The full paragraph and utility copy remain legible at use size, with clear contrast and no text-image collision.

space.location: upper-right paragraph and lower care row
space.observation: The paragraph begins left of the rest of the right text block, while its last line and the care row approach the right page edge. These offsets and tight right clearances make the text area feel squeezed rather than optically settled.

space.location: care line near right border and lower-left title
space.observation: The care row reaches close to the right edge, whereas the isolated lower-left title has a separate broad anchor on the apron. The asymmetric text margins do not consistently reinforce the image's diagonal.

image_material.location: face, hands, leaves, root ball and terracotta
image_material.observation: Dry painted strokes are coherent across the worker and plant; the supported root mass, fibrous roots and earth-covered pot make the action believable. The hands and pot rim remain legible within the painterly treatment.

emotion_control.observation: The person's focused gaze and hands supporting the root ball convey patient, tactile care. Earthy marks add warmth appropriate to a leisurely plant market and repotting activity.

ai_slop.observation: The visible fingers support the soil mass and pot rim coherently, foliage connects to the root area, and brush texture follows the depicted materials. No arbitrary symbols or conspicuous generated geometry defects are visible.

residuals: The very large explanation competes with the action scene and distances the poster identity from the event block; hierarchy is functional but unresolved.
Right-side text has inconsistent left starts and tight edge clearance, especially the care row; spacing is below the professional floor.

evidence.location: alternating image and text rows

evidence.location: table opening, sill opening and invitation headline
evidence.observation: The dominant invitation and wall paragraph lead into event copy framed by a table, with identity under a sill and a tree at right. evidence.location: whole-set relationships
evidence.observation: All five shift spatial organization and type emphasis as well as image treatment: upper-left name in M1, top tagline in M2, large paragraph in M3, date in M4 and invitation in M5. These are substantial route differences, not merely material or filter names. Repeated houseplant subjects, similar earthy colors and recurring plain sans-serif utility type prevent exceptional set diversity.

residuals: The systems share cream, green and earthy brown relationships, recurrent potted foliage and mostly sans-serif attendance typography.
M2 and M5 both rely on a large right-side home plant; M3 and M4 both center repotting. Their organization is different enough for strong diversity, but subject and mood variety remain limited.

procedure.method: Independent fresh-session portfolio review of only the explicitly pinned inputs. The packet declares zero source assets and zero protected layouts, so there were zero source-image opens and zero protected-layout reads. All five pinned native-evidence manifests were read before any poster open, without following their unlisted embedded producer paths. Using tools.view_image with detail original, and functions.image to expose each returned image, I actually opened and visually inspected exactly this initial sequence: R20-C1-M1 native, usage720, thumbnail320; R20-C1-M2 native, usage720, thumbnail320; R20-C1-M3 native, usage720, thumbnail320; R20-C1-M4 native, usage720, thumbnail320; R20-C1-M5 native, usage720, thumbnail320. All fifteen first poster views were completed before the first copy-reading/transcription stage, any mandatory judgment, any rating or diversity judgment. First readings of all sixty copy entries were retained separately in packet order. One genuine vowel ambiguity in M5 copy index 9 then prompted one additional opening of its exact pinned native view; both readings are retained and the glyph difference resolved without changing the first read. Total actual poster opens: fifteen initial views plus that one native revisit. Hash/byte checks and PNG-header dimension reads were binding checks, not substitutes for viewing. Every native is 1672×941; every usage720 is 720×405 and every thumbnail320 is 320×180. The native 16:9 result uses the predeclared 0.5 px single-edge height rounding tolerance, not mathematically exact equality. No peer review, maker inspection, source intention or tool/session identity was inferred.
